python3 -B -c "from pathlib import Path; import socket,sys; root=Path.cwd().resolve(); matched=0; other=0
for p in Path("/proc").iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdigit(): continue
 try:
  args=[v.decode("utf8","replace") for v in (p/"cmdline").read_bytes().split(b"\\0") if v]
  if "tumblrkit.appserve" not in args or "serve" not in args: continue
  if (p/"cwd").resolve()==root: matched+=1
  else: other+=1
 except (OSError,PermissionError,ValueError): continue
s=socket.socket();s.settimeout(0.6);live=s.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1",8081))==0;s.close();print("OWNER_PROCESS_MATCH_COUNT="+str(matched));print("OTHER_APP_PROCESS_COUNT="+str(other));print("PORT_8081="+("LISTENING" if live else "CLOSED"));sys.exit(60+2*min(matched,4)+int(live))"
